evidence.claim: Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Customer C11923 reported an unauthorized $131.30 online transaction (ID 3583368) on card C11923-K2. The charge was conducted via device D009621, which was marked as new for this account and substantially exceeded the cardholder's previous maximum transaction of $47.02. Network analysis revealed that device D009621 was shared across three other cards within a three-day window for similar amounts, including a transaction scoring 0.90 on the bank's fraud model. Given the customer's explicit denial, the cross-card device compromise, and ten prior confirmed fraud cases on the card, the transaction was confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present activity identified on card C11923-K2 under customer C11923. On December 29, 2016, at 03:27:44 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3583368) totaling $131.30 was processed against the card. The transaction was conducted via device D009621 (device profile: SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | unknown), which was new to the cardholder's account. Customer C11923 contacted the financial institution to dispute the charge, stating that they never authorized or made the $131.30 purchase. The disputed charge significantly deviated from the cardholder's established history, where the previous highest charge was $47.02. Knowledge graph analysis identified that device D009621 was concurrently utilized across three other distinct cards (C05595-K1, C03938-K1, and C05678-K1) within a three-day window to conduct online transactions of similar amounts between $125.00 and $131.30. A linked transaction on connected card C05595-K1 generated a high fraud model score of 0.90, indicating coordinated multi-card exploitation by a shared actor. Furthermore, card C11923-K2 carries ten prior confirmed fraud closed cases, reflecting recurrent compromise vulnerability. Total unauthorized exposure for this alert is $131.30. The financial institution has blocked card C11923-K2, declined pending activity, and initiated monitoring across all connected cards.
